const cmds = [
  {
    cmd: "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE, MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w28-20260925'
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
load = lambda p: loader.load_path(p, logical_path='tome-ashes-urhrok.lua').records
before = load(task / 'baseline/tome-ashes-urhrok.lua')
after = load(root / 'tome-ashes-urhrok.lua')
items = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
assert len(before) == len(after) == 900
assert len(items) == 24
allowed = {(x['section'], x['source'], x['source_tag']): x for x in items}
assert len(allowed) == 24
placeholder = re.compile(r'%[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]')
changed = []
changed_targets = {}
for old, new in zip(before, after):
    left = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != 'line'}
    right = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != 'line'}
    if left == right:
        continue
    key = (old.get('section'), old.get('source'), old.get('source_tag'))
    assert key in allowed, ('outside workset', key)
    item = allowed[key]
    assert old['target'] == item['target_preimage'], item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert {k: v for k, v in left.items() if k != 'target'} == {k: v for k, v in right.items() if k != 'target'}, ('non-target drift', item['entry_revision_identity'])
    assert placeholder.findall(new['source']) == placeholder.findall(new['target']), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(new['source']) == MARKUP_RE.findall(new['target']), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new['source']) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new['target']), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert new['source'].count('\n') == new['target'].count('\n'), item['entry_revision_identity']
    tabs = lambda s: [len(x) - len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in s.split('\n')]
    assert tabs(new['source']) == tabs(new['target']), item['entry_revision_identity']
    rid = item['entry_revision_identity']
    changed.append(rid)
    changed_targets[rid] = new['target']
assert len(changed) == 24
assert set(changed) == {x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in items}
rid1 = '4dd916e4cbcf28e4aec901cfe7240fb6ff481645fcf9643533396ba87a771432'
rid2 = '55dedd24042aae125f4b5dc8c45eb4688e9f1fc2d3283c3487fd82fc1a85cd5d'
t1, t2 = changed_targets[rid1], changed_targets[rid2]
for expected in (
    '让他无法为害，却也毫发无伤',
    '却只给他们自己的#{italic}##FIREBRICK#[花园]#{normal}##LAST#造成一道#{italic}##FIREBRICK#[发丝裂纹]#{normal}##LAST#',

    '换来一座新的#{italic}##FIREBRICK#[花园]#{normal}##LAST#，取代#{italic}##FIREBRICK#[蛋形杂草]#{normal}##LAST#或他们的#{italic}##FIREBRICK#[嫩芽]#{normal}##LAST#从我们手中偷走的那一座',
):

    left = {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k != 'line'}; right = {k:v for k,v in new.items() if k != 'line'}
    if left == right: continue
    key = (old.get('section'), old.get('source'), old.get('source_tag')); assert key in allowed, ('outside workset', key)
